svg.text: The runaway is the judge's taste, applied round after round —
random selection on the same lucky seed just decays
Each round the model writes 6 answers per question, a judge keeps 2, and the model fine-tunes on the kept answers. Pool = mean candidate risk of the 6-answer pool;
selection gap = mean risk of the kept answers minus the pool mean; null percentile = the observed gap's rank among 4,000 random 2-of-6 keeps of the same pool.
A. One seed, four judges — only the frozen
mean candidate risk of the pool
B. Pool drift tracks the same-round selection gap
selection gap this round (kept answers minus the pool)
pool drift into the next round
C. The Qwen self-judge fan needs no gap
summed selection gap over the run's 4 rounds
OLMo, K2 (all four judges) — pool move
Qwen, K1, judging itself — behavior move
